scope: A locally authored three-string XRECORD inserted in a pinned existing ODA DXF, converted by ODA to AC1018 DWG and then AC1021 DXF. Only the inserted XRECORD is locally authored; the base drawing is not. No sample fixture is committed and no cross-producer support claim is made.

base.provenance: See p5-ac1018-table-descendant-graph-wire-2026-11-11.json; this same-vendor 2004 DXF came from audited ODA conversion of the pinned AC1018 TABLE source.

authored_input.encoding: ANSI_1252 header and CP1252 bytes; actual code-1 value café—€ bytes 63 61 66 e9 97 80. Code-2 and code-3 use ASCII DXF Unicode escapes \U+0416 and \U+6F22.
authored_input.object: Locally inserted NOD entry CODEPAGE_PROBE soft-points to XRECORD 0x7ffe; groups 1, 2 and 3 carry the controlled values.

producer.raw_layout: Each source string uses RS length, RC codepage 45 and exactly that many UTF-8 bytes; XRECORD common owner H code 4 points to NOD 0xc. The bit walk reaches declared body end bit 331 and owner end bit 347.
producer.observed_caveat: Input group 1 includes U+20AC as CP1252 byte 0x80, but producer decoded it as U+0080 and stored c2 80; the roundtrip returns U+0080. The ODA producer thus does not preserve that input value. The raw DWG values and ODA DXF output do agree under UTF-8 for this one producer profile.

independent.result: LibreDWG independently identifies the XRECORD and owner but its minJSON text projection gives mojibake/truncation, including group 2 Ð– for actual UTF-8 Ж; it does not qualify text semantics.
independent.source_code: https://github.com/LibreDWG/libredwg/blob/6d6a33987a1a97095b069c799c3d8a793320f812/src/decode.c reads RS length and RC codepage but retains raw pre-2007 string bytes. https://github.com/LibreDWG/libredwg/blob/6d6a33987a1a97095b069c799c3d8a793320f812/src/codepages.h declares header UTF8=0 and lists through 44, with no numeric 45. This enum is for header codepage; it does not resolve XRECORD value-byte 45.
independent.acadsharp: https://github.com/DomCR/ACadSharp/blob/3a52a52047e84670759c1f9ad3916ec3ce85ff56/src/ACadSharp/IO/DWG/DwgStreamReaders/DwgStreamReaderBase.cs reads RS length and RC encoding key, but directly casts the byte to its separate Windows-codepage enum; no 45 mapping is established. Its indexed codepage array stops at 44.
independent.zuken_registry: https://www.zuken.com/doc/e3/series/en/Content/reference/dialogs/project_mode/export/IDD_FILESPECIAL_DXFEXPORT.htm documents value 45 as utf8 in its own DXF/DWG export registry; adjacent values align with 30/43/44 mappings, but that is an application setting and does not define the DWG XRECORD value-byte contract.
independent.bentley_note: https://bentleysystems.service-now.com/community?id=kb_article&sysparm_article=KB0109717 ties a DWG codepage-45 diagnostic to the Windows UTF-8 system-locale setting; it does not specify the XRECORD value-byte meaning.
independent.oda_docs: ODA v5.4.1 section 20.4.104 identifies a codepage byte for pre-R2007 XRECORD strings but neither maps 45 nor establishes that 0 inherits the file codepage. ODA IFC documentation https://www.opendesign.com/faq/ifc names CP_UTF_8 but does not give its numeric enum value or assert DWG on-wire meaning.

commands.author: python3 tools/research/p5_xrecord_codepage45_verify.py author --base-dxf /private/tmp/p5-desc-dxf-2004/input.dxf --output /private/tmp/p5-cp45-authored-repro.dxf
commands.oda_dwg: Place authored input in an otherwise empty input directory, then invoke ODAFileConverter <input-dir> <dwg-output-dir> ACAD2004 DWG 0 1 '*.dxf'.
commands.capture: Build tools/research/p5_xrecord_codepage_capture.cpp against the isolated e5341dd31d686c529ba2f8172de56868bc3551b9 adapter and library using the same recipe as the descendant graph receipt; pass the source DWG and a new raw-body output file.
commands.result: PASS; report sha256 345e30859642d29e38c03a51e864344eb732eddd0f2cb236d5d7dbb8b7a34191. Pinned hashes bind this one run; ODA output may contain changing metadata, so regenerations require new hash receipts rather than assuming byte identity.

remaining: Treat 45-as-UTF-8 as a discriminating ODA-selected-producer observation, not a general DWG XRECORD rule; retain unknown-codepage fail-closed behavior pending authoritative XRECORD mapping or independent producer/consumer with non-ASCII witness. Codepage 0 inheritance is unresolved. Any later implementation must bind exact source bytes, validate UTF-8 including invalid/truncated/overlong sequences, preserve raw values/codepage, distinguish file codepage, test failures/retries and avoid silent fallback or mutation. Do not broaden support or TABLE output from the probe.
